solutionApproaches.title: Brute Force Pairs
solutionApproaches.explanation: Try every pair of different indices. It is easy to reason about, but repeats comparisons as the array grows.

solutionApproaches.title: Hash Map
solutionApproaches.explanation: Scan once and remember earlier values. Each complement lookup is constant time on average.
